*   `?g A3`: Main Concept is A3 (Work / Occupation).
    *   `+ G14`: Cube on G14 (Turn / Around / Cycle / Repetition) in the main concept group (`g`). This suggests an occupation involving repetition, cycles, or turning.
    *   `!r A4`: Red Sub-Concept is A4 (Fauna / Animal).
    *   `+ H10`: Cube on H10 (Small / Low) in the red group.
    *   `+ Grey`: Cube on Grey in the red group.
    *   `!y D3`: Yellow Sub-Concept is D3 (Fast / Race).
